recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless future generated dataelements artifacts reintroduce duplicate Bundle fullUrl or resource.url values.
issue_request: FHIR-8622 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I DSTU1 change request reporting that validation.zip's dataelements.xml contained many distinct DataElement resources with duplicate canonical url values and duplicate Bundle.entry.fullUrl values.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 6598, represented by git commit 7f6f7f7841bf231bdffd1de8a275973c950e472a, which changed ProfileGenerator to cache generated DataElement resources by path-derived id and add only one Bundle entry per generated DataElement.
additional_context: Current source has DataElement commented out of source/fhir.ini and records DataElement as removed in the R4 history page. The current Downloads page no longer lists validation.zip, and no dataelements XML/JSON artifact is checked into source. The remaining relevant dataelements XML/JSON files are generated artifacts linked from the ElementDefinition page. A later same-family issue, FHIR-26461, is already represented on the combined branch and also audited current generated dataelements output.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The historical generator fix addressed the original DSTU1 duplicate-entry problem, and a current build.fhir.org check found both dataelements.json and dataelements.xml contain 328 StructureDefinition entries with zero duplicate fullUrl values and zero duplicate resource.url values.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue reported duplicate fullUrl/version pairs in dataelements.json; it is already audited on the combined branch and supports that the current generated artifact is clean.
Later Bundle bdl-7 uniqueness refinement is already represented on the combined branch and is compatible with this no-change decision.
Later Bundle bdl-7 absent-versionId refinement is already represented on the combined branch and is compatible with this no-change decision.
